Encounter.Name: Protection Money
Encounter.DescriptionText: While your colonies are busy growing, an unregistered ship drops out of warp at the edge of your territory and hails you. The transmission is signed "The Orion Syndicate":

Message.Text:
Dearest SING friends,
We are so pleased that you have found a few new worlds. Space is a dangerous place, and all those freighters flying between your colonies are so very exposed. Pirates, Nausicaans, raiders from the Badlands, you would be amazed what is out there.
So here is our proposal. You pay the Orion Syndicate MONEY credits now, and we will see to it that nothing unfortunate happens to your SING ships. If you decline, we cannot make any promises about what happens to them.
With warmest regards, Harcourt Fenton Mudd, Independent Trader and Gentleman (acting on behalf of the Orion Syndicate)

Response.Text: Agree to pay this gentleman his protection money.

Message.Text: Splendid! A sensible SING is a rich SING. The Syndicate will remember your generosity. Until we need something else, sleep well and safe flying.
How disappointing. We hoped we could be friends. We will see how long your freighters last without the Syndicate's goodwill. Remember, you were asked politely.
Is this some sort of SING joke? You do not have the credits! That is not the Syndicate's problem. We will collect our payment from your freighters instead.
